paragraphs.text:
You noticed flecks or flakes of dry, transparent material. It 
looks like skin. Whoever was here was peeling like a water-
soaked ceiling! Baffled, you find no answer to this puzzle. No 
more evidence can be found here. 
Go to any Arkham Location. 
(165)
